legacy_default.reason: Superstage S1 says a root with no Planning mode field is legacy incremental regardless of SUPER_PLANNING_MODE and must not be rewritten.

bounded_unknown.reason: Superstage S2 permits bounded predecessor-dependent internal filenames when the stage gives a resolution method, but S3 requires a current verified PREPARED receipt before execution.

missing_architecture.reason: Superstage S2 forbids deferring architecture or the chosen approach; unbounded foundational uncertainty makes the upfront graph invalid.

open_provider.reason: Superstage S3 requires verified integrated delivery: an open PR and absent merge commit do not satisfy a consumer dependency, so S02 is non-executable and the goal is not done.

declined_provider.reason: Superstage S3 says an authorized provider decline closes only that provider obligation; it does not deliver a live consumer contract, so S02 remains non-executable and the goal is not done until an adopted replan removes or replaces the dependency.

dependency_cycle.reason: Superstage S2 classifies cycles among active dependency edges as BLOCKED.

temporary_upfront_gate.reason: Supertraverse C6's Task 1 transition gate requires BLOCKED for every upfront planning or execution selection until Tasks 3 and 5 install preparation and operation-routing consumers.

local_detail.reason: Superstage S4 assigns refinement to PLAN_REFINER when scope, acceptance, chosen approach, dependency edges, and shared contract semantics survive; filenames, helper names, and test setup are bounded refinements.

contract_break.reason: Superstage S4 requires structural replanning by REPLANNER when verified evidence changes shared contract behavior or semantic revision relied on by downstream consumers.
